_comment: Golden prompts for scripts/eval.py --agent methane. expected_tools is a SUBSEQUENCE of the streamed tool calls; forbidden_text must not appear. reverse_geocode (ArcGIS MCP) is never expected: the gate must not fail on a third-party outage. Permian Basin 2024 = 39 plume complexes in EMITL2BCH4PLM.002; their GeoTIFFs are cached in s3://<bucket>/methane/cache/ after the first triage. "operations" / " leak" are forbidden everywhere: the agent describes, it does not attribute. closer_max_chars: the spoken closing paragraph must fit the 280-character caption band. closer_endswith: the last paragraph (the spoken closer) must end with the short confidence line.

prompts.name: plumes-permian
prompts.prompt: Show me methane plumes EMIT detected over the Permian Basin in 2024
required_text: EMIT sees the methane, not its source.
prompts.closer_endswith: EMIT sees the methane, not its source.

prompts.name: triage-permian
prompts.prompt: Find the methane plumes EMIT detected over the Permian Basin in 2024 and rank them by how much methane they carry
required_text: EMIT sees the methane, not its source.
prompts.closer_endswith: EMIT sees the methane, not its source.

prompts.name: strongest-plume
prompts.prompt: Find the strongest methane plume EMIT saw over the Permian Basin in 2024 and show me what is on the ground beneath it
required_text: EMIT sees the methane, not its source.
prompts.closer_endswith: EMIT sees the methane, not its source.
